featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.
	 
 # You can park in any city within the play area
 ![](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif)
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Ghost Hunters**
* All standard Arcade server rules apply unless stated below. Rules marked with an asterisk on the Official [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) do not apply.
* Free roaming is prohibited outside the [playable area](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/3a343db1-8a33-4f4e-8370-411b9c5a4e98.avif).
* Participants must remain inside the map boundaries, as per §2.5 - Reckless Driving.
* Participants are permitted to drive any vehicle including a truck, bus, car, or AI vehicle.
* Participants should park in any company yard in a city listed on the "playable area" map before the start of the event. 
* Participants are prohibited from leaving the starting cities until an Event Manager has announced the event has begun.

featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Tirana.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

today.name: FIESTA DE LOS DECEPTICONS
today.description:
La atmósfera de Cybertron vibraba con un zumbido eléctrico de pura satisfacción. Los Autobots habían sido repelidos y la victoria pertenecía por completo a la facción de los tiranos. En la plaza central de la fortaleza, Megatron observaba la formación de sus tropas, su figura imponente iluminada por los destellos intermitentes de la maquinaria pesada.
A un costado, Starscream ordenaba a los Vehicons acelerar el paso. Una enorme carga de fuegos artificiales de plasma estaba lista para ser detonada. No eran explosivos comunes; eran cartuchos modificados con energón crudo, diseñados especialmente para pintar los cielos con los colores de la conquista.

# 🎃👻 Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026 👻🎃

As darkness falls and ghostly figures begin to roam the roads, it's time for the **Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy**!

On October 31st, 2026, we invite you to join us for an unforgettable night filled with spooky vibes, impressive truck formations, and a strong sense of community. Together, we'll transform the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 into a haunting parade of lights, shadows, and Halloween spirit.

This convoy is all about bringing the community together. Whether you're part of a VTC, driving with friends, or joining on your own, everyone is welcome to take part in this spooky celebration.

### ***Important Information:***
* Registration is required.
* VTCs can book dedicated slots.
* Please provide an approximate participant count when booking a slot.
* Halloween-themed truck paint jobs and decorations are highly encouraged.

Let's make this Halloween night one to remember and show what the TruckersMP community is capable of when we come together.

We look forward to welcoming you to the Van Herk Group Halloween Convoy 2026!

🎃 Stay spooky and drive safe! 👻

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 🎃 ***Event Information***

* 📅 Date: October 31st, 2026
* 🕖 Meet-Up: 19:00 (Timezone: Europe/Amsterdam)
* 🚛 Departure: 20:00 (Timezone: Europe/Amsterdam)

### 🎟️ ***Registration***

* ⚠️ Registration is required.
* 🚚 VTCs can reserve dedicated slots.

### **Slot booking is open until October 28, 2026.**


### 👻 ***Halloween Theme***

* 🎨 Halloween-themed paint jobs aren't highly encouraged.
* 🕸️ Decorate your truck and embrace the spooky atmosphere.
* 🌙 Let's turn the roads of ETS2 into a haunting convoy experience.


### 📋 ***Convoy Rules***

* 🚫 No overtaking.
* 📏 Keep a safe distance.
* 👮 Follow instructions from Event Staff and TMP Staff.
* 🤝 Respect all participants.


### 🚛 ***Trailers & Cargo Information***

* ✅ Owned Trailers
* ✅ Company Trailers
* ✅ Dry Freighters
* ✅ Curtain Siders

* ✅ Container Trailers

### 🎃 ***Recommended Cargo***

* Pumpkins
* Food Products
* Beverages
* Retail Goods
* Decorations
* Event Equipment


## **Event Server**

### **We'd like to book a dedicated event server for this event, and we need your support to do so. Click the "I will be there" button to do just that!**



[![T7S3q-UX.jpg](https://i.postimg.cc/CxpnCCd1/Event-Supervised-By.png)](https://discord.gg/BzyFpaEghj)

# 📋 **Event Rules**

By participating in this event, you agree to follow both the official TruckersMP Rules and the additional rules listed below.

## 🎃 **Halloween Convoy Rules**

1. 🚛 Participants must follow all instructions given by Event Staff, Convoy Control, and TruckersMP Staff at all times.

2. ⏰ Please arrive on time. Late arrivals may lose their assigned slot or be redirected to the public parking area.

3. 🚫 Overtaking during the convoy is strictly prohibited unless instructed by Event Staff.

4. 📏 Maintain a safe and consistent distance from the vehicle in front of you to avoid unnecessary braking and collisions.

5. 🚨 Excessive use of beacons, horns, lights, or other accessories that may distract participants should be avoided.

6. 🚚 Only approved VTCs may park in reserved slot areas. Public participants must use the designated public parking area.

7. 🎮 Reckless driving, ramming, blocking, racing, or any form of disruptive behaviour will not be tolerated.

8. 🔄 Participants must remain on the designated convoy route unless instructed otherwise by Event Staff.

9. 💬 Respect all participants regardless of VTC affiliation, language, or experience level.

10. 🎃 Halloween-themed paint jobs and decorations are encouraged, but they must remain compliant with TruckersMP rules.

11. 📸 Event Media and Staff vehicles may temporarily move around the convoy to capture screenshots and videos. Please allow them to perform their duties safely.

12. ⚠️ Any participant causing repeated disruptions may be removed from the event at the discretion of **Event Management (S_N_Sturmy), Event Staff and TruckersMP Staff**.

👻 Most importantly: Have fun, respect others, and enjoy a spooky night with the community!

upcoming.name: Nexon Logistics November Convoy #86
upcoming.description:
![](https://cdn.nexonlogistics.com/images/events/banner/november.png)
Nexon Logistics proudly invites you to join us for our November Convoy, where the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 lead us through the breathtaking landscapes of the Nordic Horizons and Scandinavia DLCs.

Our journey begins in Ålesund, a beautiful coastal city surrounded by towering mountains and deep fjords. As engines roar to life, we set out along the E136, heading inland through some of the most scenic roads the Nordic region has to offer.

The convoy will continue through Dombås, Lillehammer, and Hamar, following the iconic E6 corridor. Along the way, drivers will experience winding mountain roads, dense forests, sparkling lakes, and the peaceful atmosphere that makes Scandinavian trucking so enjoyable.

Leaving Hamar behind, we take Route 25 and later join the E45, venturing deeper into the heart of the Nordic wilderness. Endless forests, open landscapes, and picturesque views await as we make our way across the border towards Sweden.

Our destination is Östersund, a vibrant city nestled among the lakes and forests of northern Scandinavia. Here, our convoy will come to a close, marking the end of another memorable journey shared with friends, drivers, and the trucking community.

✨ From the fjords of Norway to the forests of Sweden — every kilometer brings a new adventure. ✨

Come along, share the road, and let's create another unforgettable chapter in our convoy adventures.
